rules.title: Web - Browser LCP p75 above target for auth and authenticated dashboards

queries.A:
SELECT app_environment, context_rum_surface, percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lcp) / 1000 AS value
FROM (SELECT
    CAST(regexp_match(body, '(?:^| )lcp="?([0-9.]+)')[1] AS DOUBLE) AS lcp,
    regexp_match(body, '(?:^| )kind="?([^" ]*)')[1] AS kind,
    regexp_match(body, '(?:^| )type="?([^" ]*)')[1] AS type,
    regexp_match(body, '(?:^| )app_environment="?([^" ]*)')[1] AS app_environment,
    regexp_match(body, '(?:^| )session_id="?([^" ]*)')[1] AS session_id,
    regexp_match(body, '(?:^| )page_url="?([^" ]*)')[1] AS page_url,
    regexp_match(body, '(?:^| )context_rum_schema="?([^" ]*)')[1] AS context_rum_schema,
    regexp_match(body, '(?:^| )context_rum_quality="?([^" ]*)')[1] AS context_rum_quality,
    regexp_match(body, '(?:^| )context_rum_surface="?([^" ]*)')[1] AS context_rum_surface,
    regexp_match(body, '(?:^| )context_rum_deduplication="?([^" ]*)')[1] AS context_rum_deduplication,
    regexp_match(body, '(?:^| )context_rum_ray_id="?([^" ]*)')[1] AS context_rum_ray_id
  FROM tuist_web_logs
  WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '6 hours'
    AND body LIKE '%kind=measurement%' AND body LIKE '%type=web-vitals%') m
WHERE kind = 'measurement'
  AND type = 'web-vitals'
  AND app_environment = 'prod'
  AND lcp IS NOT NULL
  AND context_rum_schema = '1'
  AND context_rum_quality = 'eligible'
  AND context_rum_deduplication = 'unique'
  AND context_rum_surface IN ('auth', 'dashboard_authenticated')
GROUP BY app_environment, context_rum_surface

rules.title: Kura - ingress returning malformed or 502 responses

queries.A:
SELECT service_name, upstream, count(*) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'service_name') AS service_name, regexp_match(body, '^[^ ]+ - - \[[^]]+\] "[A-Z]+ [^"]+" ([0-9]{3}) .* \[([^\]]+)\] \[[^\]]*\] ')[1] AS resp_status, regexp_match(body, '^[^ ]+ - - \[[^]]+\] "[A-Z]+ [^"]+" ([0-9]{3}) .* \[([^\]]+)\] \[[^\]]*\] ')[2] AS upstream
  FROM opentelemetry_logs
  WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
    AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'cluster') = 'tuist-production'
    AND regexp_like(json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'service_name'), '^kura-.*-ingress-nginx$')
) l
WHERE regexp_like(resp_status, '^(0..|502)$')
GROUP BY service_name, upstream

rules.title: Runner cache volume saves failing

queries.A:
SELECT platform, CASE WHEN saves >= 20 THEN CAST(failed AS DOUBLE) / saves ELSE 0 END AS value
FROM (
  SELECT platform, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN result IN ('invalid_image', 'incomplete', 'error', 'timeout') THEN use END) AS failed, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN result NOT IN ('unchanged', 'withheld', 'release_pending', 'cancelled') THEN use END) AS saves
  FROM (
    SELECT CASE WHEN json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'job') = 'tuist-macos-tart-kubelet' THEN 'macos' ELSE 'linux' END AS platform, COALESCE(regexp_match(body, '"result":"([^"]*)"')[1], '') AS result, COALESCE(regexp_match(body, '"use":"([^"]*)"')[1], '') AS use
    FROM opentelemetry_logs
    WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
      AND ((json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'job') = 'tuist-macos-tart-kubelet' AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'env') = 'production') AND body LIKE '%"msg":"cache phase"%' OR (json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'cluster') = 'tuist-production' AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'namespace') = 'tuist-runners' AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'service_name') = 'agent') AND body LIKE '%"msg":"cache volume operation"%')
      AND body LIKE '%"operation":"publish"%'
  ) l
  GROUP BY platform
) s

rules.title: Runner cache volume attaches unavailable

queries.A:
SELECT platform, sum(CASE WHEN platform = 'macos' AND result NOT IN ('success', 'cancelled') OR platform = 'linux' AND result NOT IN ('success', 'cancelled', 'execution_pending') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT CASE WHEN json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'job') = 'tuist-macos-tart-kubelet' THEN 'macos' ELSE 'linux' END AS platform, COALESCE(regexp_match(body, '"result":"([^"]*)"')[1], '') AS result, COALESCE(regexp_match(body, '"use":"([^"]*)"')[1], '') AS use
  FROM opentelemetry_logs
  WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
    AND ((json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'job') = 'tuist-macos-tart-kubelet' AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'env') = 'production') AND regexp_like(body, '"msg":"(cache phase","operation":"attach"|custom cache volume (not authorized;|larger than this host))') OR (json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'cluster') = 'tuist-production' AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'namespace') = 'tuist-runners' AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'service_name') = 'agent') AND body LIKE '%"msg":"cache volume operation"%' AND body LIKE '%"operation":"acquire"%')
) l
GROUP BY platform
queries.B:
SELECT platform, sum(CASE WHEN platform = 'macos' AND result <> 'cancelled' OR platform = 'linux' AND result NOT IN ('cancelled', 'execution_pending') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT CASE WHEN json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'job') = 'tuist-macos-tart-kubelet' THEN 'macos' ELSE 'linux' END AS platform, COALESCE(regexp_match(body, '"result":"([^"]*)"')[1], '') AS result, COALESCE(regexp_match(body, '"use":"([^"]*)"')[1], '') AS use
  FROM opentelemetry_logs
  WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
    AND ((json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'job') = 'tuist-macos-tart-kubelet' AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'env') = 'production') AND regexp_like(body, '"msg":"(cache phase","operation":"attach"|custom cache volume (not authorized;|larger than this host))') OR (json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'cluster') = 'tuist-production' AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'namespace') = 'tuist-runners' AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'service_name') = 'agent') AND body LIKE '%"msg":"cache volume operation"%' AND body LIKE '%"operation":"acquire"%')
) l
GROUP BY platform
